content.what_it_is: MATLAB wave-height plotter for Case_DATA2D_1Wave output 00001. It constructs a 500x250 mesh from fixed 2 m vectors, loads Hrms and a static mask, replaces masked cells by NaN, renders Hrms with a 0-0.8 m scale, overlays copper-colored points at NaN locations, and saves figures/Hrms.jpg (L1-L35).
entities: case directory fdir defined at L4
coordinate vectors x and y defined at L5-L6
file selector file_no defined numerically at L7 and reformatted at L10
mesh grids xx and yy defined at L9
wave-height array H loaded at L11 and masked at L13
colorbar handle h defined at L16
flattened coordinates XX1D/YY1D and field onedim defined at L24-L26
dry-point coordinates XX_Dry/YY_Dry defined at L27-L28
copper table colors and selected color_sand defined at L29-L30

equations.ref: mask Hrms where static mask is zero
select sand point color from copper table

calls: clear, clc, and close all at L1
unresolved: Range/version risk at L29-L30: copper is called without an explicit row count and row 190 is indexed. MATLAB environments returning a legacy 64-row default colormap raise an out-of-range error.
H and mask at L11-L13 are assumed to match the fixed 500x250 coordinate grid at L5-L9; no dimension check precedes masking or pcolor.
Dry points at L27-L31 include every NaN in H after masking, so pre-existing numerical NaNs are indistinguishable from mask-derived dry cells.
MATLAB pcolor at L15 ordinarily omits the final H row and column as colored faces.
The figures directory used at L34 is not created or checked before saveas.
